clue.text: Excuse certain satisfaction

blocks.note: a plea is an excuse offered in defence
sure means certain

explanation.surface: Someone apologises for feeling a definite sense of contentment.
explanation.definitionFit: Pleasure is the enjoyment felt when a want is met, a close synonym of satisfaction.

clue.text: Thick soup in container on time

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed after, so time follows the container

blocks.note: a pot is a container
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A broth served in a pot right on schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: Potage is a French word for a thick soup, borrowed into English for hearty purees.

clue.text: Flowering plant first in bloom? Rejoicing about that

indicators.note: first in a word means its opening letter is the only one kept
about means surrounding, so the rejoicing word goes round the selected letter

blocks.note: euphoria is intense joy
the first letter of bloom

explanation.surface: A gardener is overjoyed at a plant's first flower.
explanation.walkthrough: B goes inside EUPHORIA, between R and I; 'that' points back to the selected letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Euphorbia is a large genus of spurges, many grown as ornamental flowering garden plants.

clue.text: Hide final pieces of fabulous treasure on island

indicators.note: final pieces means the last letter of each of the next two words is kept
in a down clue on means sitting above, so the letters come before the island

blocks.note: the last letters of fabulous and treasure
Crete is the largest Greek island

explanation.surface: Bury the last of a legendary hoard on an island, like a pirate.
explanation.definitionFit: To secrete something is to conceal it in a hiding place, a formal synonym of hide as a verb.

clue.text: Speak angrily about pressure for plan without initial reconciliation

indicators.note: without initial means the plan word loses its opening letter
about means surrounding, so the angry speech wraps the other pieces

blocks.note: to rant is to speak angrily and at length
p is the symbol for pressure
pro means in favour of, for
a scheme is a plan

explanation.surface: Someone furious about being pushed toward a deal that has lost its first step.
explanation.walkthrough: Rapprochement is borrowed from French, so its spelling is unusual in English; 'for' supplies a Latin-derived word meaning in favour.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapprochement is a French word for the re-establishing of friendly relations, especially between nations.

clue.text: Beginning with greeting after hesitation letting doctor in

indicators.note: letting a thing in means admitting it, so one piece sits inside the hesitation sound
after places the greeting behind the hesitation in the final order

blocks.note: er is the sound of someone hesitating
MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine
yo is a slangy hello

explanation.surface: Someone stammers before saying hello to a doctor at the door.
explanation.walkthrough: The doctor here is a medical degree, the Bachelor of Medicine, rather than the usual DR or MO.
explanation.definitionFit: An embryo is something at its earliest stage of development, figuratively the start or germ of anything.

clue.text: Lack of pretension in manner with pen

indicators.note: with means alongside, so the enclosure word is joined after the manner word

blocks.note: a mode is a way or manner
a sty is a pen for pigs

explanation.surface: An unassuming way of writing with a humble pen.
explanation.walkthrough: The pen is an animal enclosure, not a writing tool.
explanation.definitionFit: Modesty is humility about oneself, the absence of any showing off or airs.

clue.text: One resisting authority figure belittled to some extent

indicators.note: to some extent says only part of the following words is used

blocks.note: the letters run across the join of the two words

explanation.surface: A dissident leader has been somewhat diminished.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebel is someone who rises against or defies those in power, so one resisting authority.

clue.text: Superior to receive pass

blocks.note: over means above or superior to
to take is to receive

explanation.surface: A boss collecting a permit from a subordinate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pass' looks like a noun such as a ticket; it is the verb used of cars on a road.
explanation.definitionFit: To overtake another vehicle is to pass it by drawing level and moving ahead.

clue.text: Question highest in command

blocks.note: top means highest
i/c is the standard abbreviation for in charge or in command

explanation.surface: A query is put to the most senior officer present.
explanation.definitionFit: A question in the sense of a matter under discussion is a topic, as in 'the question of funding'.

clue.text: Old man, very bold, moving with energy in dance

indicators.note: moving suggests letters being shifted about into a new arrangement

blocks.note: pa is a familiar word for father
so as in 'so good' means very
taken as written
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Dad, feeling daring, throws himself energetically about the dance floor.
explanation.definitionFit: The paso doble is a lively Spanish-style ballroom dance modelled on a bullfight march.

clue.text: One following order in full adjusted his aerial

indicators.note: following places the one word after the order word
in means placed inside, so the first pieces go within the full word
adjusted means altered or rearranged, so the letters are reordered

blocks.note: to tell someone to do something is to order them
I is the Roman numeral for one
sated means full up after eating
taken as written

explanation.surface: An obedient person, carrying out instructions to the letter, repositions a man's antenna.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One following order' reads like a loyal underling, but 'order' is a verb meaning command and 'one' is a numeral placed after it.
explanation.definitionFit: A satellite dish is the bowl-shaped receiving aerial that picks up broadcast signals from orbit.

clue.text: Travel in good group involving zero risk, right?

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the group word wraps around the others

blocks.note: G is the usual abbreviation for good
a lot is a group or batch
O looks like the number zero
a bet is a risk or gamble
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether travelling with a decent group is completely safe.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark hides the final abbreviation for right, which also sits inside the group word.
explanation.definitionFit: To globetrot is to travel widely and frequently around the world, a colourful verb for travel.

clue.text: Share in rent

blocks.note: first meaning: divide something up between people
second meaning: a tear or crack, rent as a noun

explanation.surface: Flatmates paying their portion of the monthly housing cost.
explanation.walkthrough: Rent looks like money paid to a landlord, but here it is a tear, as in a rent in the fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means divide between people; as a noun it names a tear or crack, matching a rent.

clue.text: Fantastic help by clerk at code-breaking headquarters

indicators.note: fantastic means wild and fanciful, so the letters that follow are rearranged freely

blocks.note: every letter of these words is used

explanation.surface: An office worker gives wonderful assistance at a secret wartime base.
explanation.walkthrough: BLETCHLEY PARK is the English country house where Allied codebreakers, Turing among them, cracked Enigma in the Second World War.
explanation.definitionFit: The Buckinghamshire estate was the centre of British wartime cryptanalysis, the Government Code and Cypher School's base.

clue.text: Car is not damaged in tests

indicators.note: damaged means knocked out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: Audi is a German make of car
taken as written

explanation.surface: A vehicle comes through its inspections unscathed.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests an MOT test on a car; the tests are trials for performers.
explanation.definitionFit: Auditions are trial performances where actors or musicians are tested for a role or place.

clue.text: Poor cleric, without work, in the red

indicators.note: without work means the abbreviation for a work is removed from the cleric
in means placed inside the colour word

blocks.note: a bishop is a senior cleric; removing OP, a musical work (opus), leaves BISH
ruby is a deep red colour

explanation.surface: A clergyman out of a job and in debt is badly off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the red' suggests debt, but the red is a gemstone colour; the work removed is an opus, abbreviated OP.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubbishy means of low quality or worthless, the sense of poor as in poor workmanship.

clue.text: Underrated beginner in ultimate card game babbled, holding diamonds back

indicators.note: the beginner of a word is its opening letter, so only that one is kept
back means the stones word is read from its end to its start
holding means grasping, so the babbling word surrounds the other piece

blocks.note: the first letter of ultimate
nap is an old trick-taking card game, short for Napoleon
to prate is to babble or chatter foolishly
ice is slang for diamonds

explanation.surface: A novice in some final card game chattered on while clutching his diamond cards.
explanation.walkthrough: Diamonds look like the card suit in this card-game surface, but they are gems, which slang calls by a frozen name.
explanation.definitionFit: Something underrated is valued below its worth, which is exactly what unappreciated means.

clue.text: Contribute feature below mine

indicators.note: in a down answer below means the face feature comes after the mine word

blocks.note: a pit is a coal mine
the chin is a facial feature

explanation.surface: A notable landmark stands beneath a colliery.
explanation.definitionFit: To pitch in is an idiom for joining in and helping, giving one's share of effort or money.

clue.text: Idiosyncrasy about service following trade

indicators.note: about means around, so the quirk word goes round the other pieces

blocks.note: a tic is a habitual quirk
the RAF, the Royal Air Force, is one of the armed services
f is the abbreviation for following, as in pp 10f

explanation.surface: A personal quirk concerning military life once someone leaves commerce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Following trade' looks like a link, but 'following' supplies F and trade is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Traffic means dealing or commerce in goods, often illicit, so it is a synonym of trade.

clue.text: Tips for calligraphy, given excellent new pen?

definitions.note: the question mark flags a definition by example

indicators.note: tips are the two ends of each word, so only outer letters are kept

blocks.note: the first and last letters of calligraphy
the first and last letters of given
the first and last letters of excellent

explanation.surface: Advice on handwriting for someone who has just received a fine new pen.
explanation.walkthrough: A pen is a female swan, so a new pen is a young swan; the writing surface hides this.
explanation.definitionFit: A cygnet is a baby swan, and a pen is the female swan, so a newborn female is a cygnet.

clue.text: Produce alien after appeal

indicators.note: after places the alien word behind the appeal word

blocks.note: to beg is to appeal or plead
ET is the extraterrestrial of the Spielberg film

explanation.surface: A space creature is created following a plea.
explanation.definitionFit: To beget is to father or bring into being, so it is a formal synonym of produce as a verb.

clue.text: Country in hour covered by a horse going north

indicators.note: in a down clue going north means reading upward, from end to start
covered by means wrapped inside, so the hour letter goes within the horse phrase

blocks.note: h is the abbreviation for hour
a nag is an old horse

explanation.surface: A traveller rides north on horseback for an hour through a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Ghana is a nation in West Africa, formerly the Gold Coast, so it fits country.

clue.text: Sad poem about soldier perhaps with line in refined style

indicators.note: about means around, so the poem wraps the other pieces

blocks.note: an elegy is a mournful poem
a soldier is one caste of ant, hence perhaps
L is the abbreviation for line

explanation.surface: A lament about a soldier, written with a fine turn of phrase.
explanation.walkthrough: The soldier is an insect: soldier castes guard ant colonies, hence 'perhaps'.
explanation.definitionFit: To do something elegantly is to do it gracefully and with polish, which is acting in refined style.

clue.text: Pasta that pigeons ruined? Not on

indicators.note: not on tells us the small word on must be removed from the fodder
ruined means wrecked, so the letters are broken up and rebuilt

blocks.note: taken as written, before removal

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether birds have spoilt a plate of noodles, and exclaims it is unacceptable.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing O and N from THAT PIGEONS leaves nine letters that rearrange into the pasta. 'Not on' reads as 'unacceptable!' in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Spaghetti is long thin string-like pasta, a specific example of the general food category.

clue.text: Father with particular expression of disapproval

blocks.note: Fr is the abbreviation for a priest's title, Father
own as in 'my own' means particular to someone

explanation.surface: A priest has his own special look of displeasure.
explanation.definitionFit: A frown is a furrowing of the brow that shows a person is displeased, a facial expression of disapproval.

clue.text: Variable merits in wishes

blocks.note: y is a standard algebraic variable
to earn something is to merit it

explanation.surface: Changing deserts of people reflected in what they hope for.
explanation.definitionFit: He yearns means he longs or pines for something, a strong form of the verb wishes.

clue.text: Stocky son cutting mass of trees

indicators.note: cutting means slicing into, so one letter is pushed inside the trees word

blocks.note: s is the abbreviation for son
a thicket is a dense mass of trees or shrubs

explanation.surface: A sturdy boy hacks his way through a dense copse.
explanation.definitionFit: A thickset person is heavily built and broad, a near synonym for stocky.
